text:
Ivy Chen: hi team! i'm ivy, joining today as a product analyst. i'm in seattle (remote) but planning a trip to the SF office next month. pronouns she/her. hobbies: late-night cheesemaking experiments and terrible crossword puns. excited to meet y'all! :cheese:
Luca: welcome Ivy!! :tada: your cheesemaking skills sound wild. when you're in SF we'll do the office tasting panel. also, if you want mentors for metrics stuff ping me.
Zoe: hi Ivy, welcome — love the crossword puns. we have a weekly remote coffee hang on Thursdays at 10am PT if you'd like to swing by. :coffee: also we run a tiny trivia channel on Fridays.
Ben (IT): Ivy — badge/email/profiles done. If you need dual-monitor shipping to Seattle, reply with your laptop model and desk preferences. Shipping ETA is ~5 business days.
Ivy Chen: thanks Ben! i have a 13" M1 macbook pro and would love a laptop stand and second monitor if that's possible.
Noah: welcome! remote folks are invited to our monthly "what's on your counter" photo share. highly recommend for cheesemakers. :camera_with_flash:
onboard-bot: Onboarding step completed: welcome_message_sent to Ivy Chen.
Luca: also quick heads-up — the office snack rotation this week includes salted caramel pretzels and kombucha. shameless plug: bring a jar of home cheese next month pls. :wink:
Ivy Chen: challenge accepted. adding "salted caramel pretzel pairing" to my notes. thanks for the warm welcome everyone!
